A1.words: manifest-name: a base name equal to a MANIFEST_NAMES entry, read for every entry at every depth from 1 to DEPTH_BOUND path segments and in every CASE_FORMS spelling
pip-name: a base name holding requirements, constraints or pylock, read for each word in every CASE_FORMS spelling and at every depth from 1 to DEPTH_BOUND
the word at every POSITION_FORMS position in the name: alone, beside a letter, a digit, -, _, . or a space on either side, inside letters, and as the extension
with every PIP_EXTENSIONS extension, .pip among them

pip-directory: every file below a directory whose name holds one of those words, read for each word in every CASE_FORMS spelling and at every DIRECTORY_FORMS position with every PIP_EXTENSIONS extension or none on the file, and for a requirements directory at every index with a file at every distance below it within DEPTH_BOUND path segments

only outside test/: every TEST_ROOT_PLANTS path below test/ is left unread and every one beside it is read; each selected path is read as raw lines but the root package.json and package-lock.json, read by their own readers; every raw line from 1 to LINE_BOUND is read, a hit named by its line

A3.words: static reading: in a script module each judged text holding a REGISTRATION_WORDS segment (register, registerNativeProviders) gives one entry per segment, at every position the planted modules of rows R, S and U2 hold

so each of these call spellings is read: direct, optional, .call, .apply, .bind, an element access by a string or template key, a Reflect.apply argument, a parenthesized callee, a destructured binding
the judged texts are the JUDGED_KINDS nodes: an identifier, a private name, a string literal, a no-substitution template, a template head, middle and tail, a regular expression, JSX text

and every REGISTER_NAME name a DECLARATION_KINDS declaration or an import or export specifier's property name spells, each REGISTER_NAME_PLANTS read name read and each quiet one not, no name hard-coded, so a const-arrow export and a renamed import are read
a script module is a file whose lower-cased extension is a SCRIPT_KINDS key, each SCRIPT_PLANTS script module parsed and each SCRIPT_PLANTS raw one, the extensionless among them, read as raw lines
in any other file every raw line's REGISTRATION_WORDS segments, every line from 1 to LINE_BOUND
near misses are not read: registered, RegisterHost, unregister, a registerTool call, and registering, $register and register_x in a string

Fiber family: a descriptor whose id folds to hold fiber, or a permission does, or its contract does, each FOLD_FORMS spelling read alone in each of the three and each FOLD_QUIET spelling in none; or whose contract starts with rf@ byte for byte, each RF_FORMS contract read alone; each criterion read alone
carrier: a family member's contract is the provider's own REACTIVE_FIBER_CONTRACT_SOURCE byte for byte: no other CARRIER_FORMS contract is, nor a contract that merely ends --no-commit

publishing: a family member that is not the read preview states each reason: each non-read effect of PLANTED_EFFECTS, each mode other than invoke in every MODE_SETS set, and a contract not ending with a space and --no-commit, each FLAG_FORMS contract read

needles: a descriptor's keys and strings are read in every planted field (its id, description, permissions, contract and input schema, the schema down to NEST_BOUND nested objects as a string and as a key) for the stem, each hosted class and each publication entry, each NEEDLE_FORMS spelling read
the live src's static reading and the live registrations' readings are pinned whole

anchors.plantGaps: - F4 INFO: (PREP F4, verbatim, flattened to one line) INFO (sub-word partial hollowings
anchors.foldDuty: FOLD DUTY (for the landing, not owed by the seat):

phrases.N-DIRECTORY: every member of a requirements/ directory regardless of extension
